solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Pass without harm when windy storm has finished

parts.note: a blow is a strong gale or windstorm
something that has finished is over

explanation.surface: Advice to wait until a gale has passed before going on your way.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm or crisis that blows over passes and leaves no lasting damage.

clue.text: Disinclined to meet a South American city seducer

parts.note: loth means reluctant or unwilling
Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian city

explanation.surface: Someone reluctant to visit a Brazilian city turns out to be a womaniser.
explanation.definitionFit: Lothario is the rake in Rowe's play The Fair Penitent, so his name became a byword for a womanising seducer.

clue.text: Talk effusively about songlike hits' sound first

indicators.note: first says the sound-alike piece goes at the front, before the other piece
sound says the word for hits is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: whacks are heavy blows or hits
lyrical means having the quality of a song

explanation.surface: A music critic discussing the sound of hit songs before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hits' sound' suggests the noise of hit records, but it means WHACKS said aloud, giving WAX; 'about' is a link, as one waxes lyrical about something.
explanation.definitionFit: To wax lyrical is an idiom for speaking about something with great enthusiasm.

clue.text: Empty thinker

parts.note: looks like a slight on a brainless person, but means one who believes in the existence of empty space

explanation.surface: A dismissive label for someone with nothing in their head.
explanation.definitionFit: A philosopher who holds that a true vacuum exists is a thinker about emptiness.

clue.text: Irritable Raymond races in

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Ray is the short form of the name Raymond
TT, the Tourist Trophy motorcycle races on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Raymond gets bad-tempered when he goes in for races.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratty is informal British for cross or short-tempered.

clue.text: Spell 'exaggerate'

definitions.meaning: a period of time, as in a spell or term in prison
to overstate or push the truth beyond what is so

explanation.surface: An instruction to write out the word 'exaggerate' letter by letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch is a continuous period, and to stretch the truth is to overstate it.

clue.text: Show preference for Bible quartet included

indicators.note: included says one piece is taken inside the other

parts.note: a quartet is a group of four
AV, the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: A church singing group of four is chosen because a Bible reading is part of their act.
explanation.definitionFit: To favour something is to prefer it or treat it with partiality.

clue.text: From portal he moved more than enough

indicators.note: moved says the letters are shifted about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone moving in through a doorway brings an excessive amount with them.
explanation.definitionFit: A plethora is an excess or overabundance of something.

clue.text: Nevertheless seeking a monopoly

definitions.meaning: used to mean in spite of everything, however
a monopolist is out to get the whole of the trade, wanting every last bit

explanation.surface: Despite everything, a firm is still trying to corner the market.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in spite of everything, and read literally it is wanting the lot, like a monopolist.

clue.text: Bill enters cab. On the contrary suffering from inability to control movements

definitions.text: suffering from inability to control movements

indicators.note: enters would put one piece inside the other
on the contrary says the roles are swapped, so the cab goes inside the bill

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
a taxi is a cab

explanation.surface: A passenger with a fare problem gets into a taxi, or rather the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as written, 'enters' would put the bill inside the cab; 'On the contrary' swaps the roles, so the cab goes inside the bill instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Ataxic describes a patient with ataxia, a loss of coordination of bodily movement.

clue.text: Completely ruined whilst climbing drainpipe

definitions.meaning: a slang phrase for wrecked or lost beyond repair
literally going up a gutter downpipe, as a spider in a nursery rhyme does

explanation.surface: Things fall apart while someone is shinning up a drainpipe.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang idiom means spoiled or gone wrong, and literally describes ascending a spout.

clue.text: Put weapon down on this part of seat?

definitions.text: Put weapon down on this part of seat?

parts.words: Put weapon down on this part of seat?
parts.note: the weapon is not a gun but a limb, the arm, laid to rest on the side of a chair

explanation.surface: An order to lay down a weapon on part of a chair.
explanation.definitionFit: The support for the elbow at the side of a chair is where you rest your arm.

clue.text: Cross cat

parts.note: not an angry feline but a crossbreed of two big cats, a tiger and a lioness

explanation.surface: An angry feline.
explanation.definitionFit: A hybrid of a male tiger and a lioness is a crossbred big cat.

clue.text: Players' lively passage

parts.note: the players are musicians, and the passage is a playful, fast movement in a symphony or sonata

explanation.surface: A brisk scene in a stage play performed by actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A scherzo is a quick, light movement in a musical work, played by an orchestra.

clue.text: Can, in a way, be one's allotted task

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A question of whether a can on a road could be someone's assigned job.
explanation.definitionFit: A stint is a fixed period or amount of work assigned to someone.

clue.text: Demon drink?

parts.note: the old phrase for alcohol read another way: a demon is a wicked being, and a drink can be a spirit

explanation.surface: The old temperance name for alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon is a malign supernatural being, and spirits are strong drinks.

clue.text: Cultivated land until Thursday, only partly

indicators.note: only partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A farmer says the fields will be ploughed only partly until midweek.
explanation.definitionFit: Tilth is soil prepared by tillage, or land under cultivation.

clue.text: Merriment with this French lady

parts.note: joy is happiness or merriment
ce is French for this

explanation.surface: A cheerful French woman is introduced.
explanation.definitionFit: Joyce is a woman's first name, so a lady.

clue.text: Made music more lively?

parts.note: read literally, turned a tune into a lively style of popular music with improvisation

explanation.surface: A question about whether a tune was given more pep.
explanation.definitionFit: To jazz something up is to liven it, and literally to arrange music in a jazz style.

clue.text: View station after early evening

indicators.note: after says the station piece follows the other

parts.note: VI, Roman six, as six o'clock is early evening

explanation.surface: Seeing a railway station as night begins to fall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'early evening' tempts you to take the first letter of evening, but it is six o'clock, VI in Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a view, especially a long one seen through an opening.

clue.text: Farewell to owing money, Leo has nothing

parts.note: OD, overdrawn, is the state of a bank account owing money
taken as written
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Saying goodbye to debt, because Leo is broke.
explanation.definitionFit: This is old British slang for goodbye.

clue.text: Take a back seat

parts.note: not to step aside, but to sit on the back of a horse

explanation.surface: Advice to stay out of the limelight.
explanation.definitionFit: To get on a horse is to seat yourself on its back.

clue.text: Heard girl's nickname

indicators.note: heard says the word is taken by how it sounds

parts.note: Monica's, belonging to a girl named Monica

explanation.surface: Someone overhears a girl's pet name.
explanation.definitionFit: Moniker is slang for a name or nickname.

clue.text: Reportedly too near cooler mug

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is spelt as it is heard

parts.note: too and to sound alike
by means near, as in close by
jug and cooler are both slang for prison

explanation.surface: A cold drink in a mug is said to be too close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooler' looks like a fridge or something that chills a drink, but it is prison slang, as is JUG.
explanation.definitionFit: A Toby jug is a beer mug moulded as a seated man in a tricorn hat.

clue.text: Very large unspecified number not well in Jerusalem

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Zion is a name for Jerusalem
ill means unwell

explanation.surface: A huge number of people are sick in the holy city.
explanation.definitionFit: Zillion is informal for an enormous but indefinite quantity.

clue.text: Lady found ousel fluttering round island

indicators.note: round says one piece goes about the other
fluttering says the letters flap about into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman spots a blackbird flitting around an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fluttering' turns OUSEL into LOUSE, which goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Louise is a woman's first name, so a lady.

clue.text: Twisting to right, second electrically charged particle

parts.note: an ion is an atom or molecule with an electric charge

explanation.surface: A particle in a physics experiment spins to the right in a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Torsion is the action of twisting, as in a twisted bar or wire.

clue.text: Letter about gas, I'm perplexed

indicators.note: perplexed suggests the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone baffled by a letter concerning their gas bill.
explanation.definitionFit: Sigma is the eighteenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: One accepted by many with quite remarkable evenness of temper

indicators.note: accepted by says one piece is taken into the other
remarkable says the letters are remarked, set out differently

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone widely admired for being remarkably calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Equanimity is composure or calmness of mind under stress.

clue.text: Lower island

definitions.meaning: something that lows, a cow, here the dairy breed
the largest of the Channel Islands, off Normandy

explanation.surface: An island that sits lower than its neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jersey is a cow breed, which lows, and Jersey is a Channel Island.

clue.text: Not going with the current trend

definitions.text: Not going with the current trend

parts.words: Not going with the current trend
parts.note: read literally, moving against the flow of a river rather than against fashion

explanation.surface: Someone out of step with fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling against the river's flow is moving toward its source.

clue.text: Physicist from Sweden has anxiety with gypsy

parts.note: angst is anxiety or dread
Rom is a Romani man, a gypsy

explanation.surface: A Swedish scientist is anxious about a traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: Anders Jonas Angstrom was a Swedish physicist, remembered in a unit of length.
